Thanks for opening this pull request! We have detected this is the first time for you to contribute to *QSIPrep*. Please check out our [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/pennlinc/qsiprep/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
These are guidelines intended to make communication easier by describing a consistent process, but don't worry if you don't get it everything exactly "right" on the first try.
We invite you to list yourself as a *QSIPrep* contributor, so if your name is not already mentioned, please modify the [``CITATION.cff``](https://github.com/pennlinc/qsiprep/blob/main/CITATION.cff) file with your data. If you do so, your name will be listed as an author at the next release. Please add yourself to the list in alphabetical order, keeping Cieslak, Matthew as first and Satterthwaite, Theodore D. as last authors, e.g.:
``` ... authors:
  ...
  - family-names: <LastName>
    given-names: <FirstName>
    affiliation: <Affiliation>
    orcid: <Id>
  ...
... ```
Of course, if you want to opt out this time there is no problem at all with adding your name later. You will be always welcome to add it in the future whenever you feel it should be listed.

run.name: Run qsiprep (<< parameters.marker >>)
run.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/out /tmp/work /tmp/coverage
docker run --rm=false \
  -e CIRCLE_CPUS=<< parameters.cpus >> \
  -e COVERAGE_FILE=/coverage/.coverage.<< parameters.marker >> \
  -v /tmp/src/qsiprep:/tmp/src/qsiprep:ro \
  -v /tmp/data:/data:ro \
  -v /tmp/out:/out \
  -v /tmp/work:/work \
  -v /tmp/coverage:/coverage \
  -w /tmp/src/qsiprep \
  --entrypoint pytest \
  pennlinc/qsiprep:test \
  -rP -o log_cli=true -m "<< parameters.marker >>" \
  --cov-append --cov-report term-missing --cov=qsiprep \
  --data_dir=/data --output_dir=/out --working_dir=/work \
  qsiprep

run.name: Get base image information
Determine whether test image build is required
run.command:
if [[ -f /tmp/images/imageprep-success.marker ]]; then
  echo "BUILD_TEST_IMAGE=0" >> "$BASH_ENV"
else
  echo "No successful cached image prep for current Docker inputs; rebuilding test image."
  echo "BUILD_TEST_IMAGE=1" >> "$BASH_ENV"
fi

run.name: Build base image if needed
run.command:
if ! docker manifest inspect $BASE_IMAGE > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Base image $BASE_IMAGE not found, building..."
  docker build -f Dockerfile.base \
    --platform linux/amd64 \
    -t $BASE_IMAGE \
    -t $BASE_IMAGE_NAME:latest .
  echo "BASE_WAS_BUILT=1" >> "$BASH_ENV"
else
  echo "Base image $BASE_IMAGE already exists."
  echo "BASE_WAS_BUILT=0" >> "$BASH_ENV"
fi

run.name: Build Docker image (test)
run.command:
if [[ "$BUILD_TEST_IMAGE" == "1" || "$BASE_WAS_BUILT" == "1" ]]; then
  docker build \
    --target test \
    --rm=false \
    -t pennlinc/qsiprep:test \
    --platform linux/amd64 \
    --build-arg VCS_REF="$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" .
elif docker image inspect pennlinc/qsiprep:test > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Reusing existing local test image (no Dockerfile/pixi/base-triggered rebuild required)."
elif docker pull localhost:5000/qsiprep-test; then
  docker tag localhost:5000/qsiprep-test pennlinc/qsiprep:test
  echo "Reusing cached test image from local registry (no Dockerfile/pixi/base-triggered rebuild required)."
else
  echo "No reusable test image found; rebuilding test image."
  docker build \
    --target test \
    --rm=false \
    -t pennlinc/qsiprep:test \
    --platform linux/amd64 \
    --build-arg VCS_REF="$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" .
fi

run.name: Guard test image revision
run.command:
EXPECTED_REF="$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
IMAGE_REF="$(docker image inspect pennlinc/qsiprep:test --format '{{ index .Config.Labels "org.opencontainers.image.revision" }}')"
echo "Expected test image ref: ${EXPECTED_REF}"
echo "Actual test image ref: ${IMAGE_REF:-<missing>}"
if [[ -z "$IMAGE_REF" || "$IMAGE_REF" != "$EXPECTED_REF" ]]; then
  echo "Test image revision does not match checkout. Refusing to run tests with stale image."
  exit 1
fi

run.name: Verify test image
run.command: docker run --rm --entrypoint pytest pennlinc/qsiprep:test --version

run.name: Push base image to Docker Hub (if newly built)
run.command:
if [[ "$BASE_WAS_BUILT" == "1" ]] && docker image inspect $BASE_IMAGE > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  if [[ -n "$DOCKER_PASS" ]]; then
    docker push $BASE_IMAGE
    docker push $BASE_IMAGE_NAME:latest
  fi
fi

run.name: Download integration datasets
run.command:
download_one() {
  local dset=$1
  local url=$2
  if [[ -d /tmp/data/${dset} ]]; then
    echo "${dset} data was cached"
    return 0
  fi
  mkdir -p /tmp/data/${dset}
  if [[ "${url}" == *.xz ]]; then
    wget --retry-connrefused --waitretry=5 --read-timeout=20 --timeout=15 -t 0 -q \
      -O /tmp/${dset}.tar.xz "${url}" || return 1
    tar xJf /tmp/${dset}.tar.xz -C /tmp/data/${dset}
    rm -f /tmp/${dset}.tar.xz
  elif [[ "${url}" == *.gz ]]; then
    wget --retry-connrefused --waitretry=5 --read-timeout=20 --timeout=15 -t 0 -q \
      -O /tmp/${dset}.tar.gz "${url}" || return 1
    tar xzf /tmp/${dset}.tar.gz -C /tmp/data/${dset}
    rm -f /tmp/${dset}.tar.gz
  else
    echo "Unknown file extension for ${dset}: ${url}"
    return 1
  fi
  echo "Downloaded ${dset}"
}

run.name: Build Docker image (production)
run.command:
if [[ -n "$CIRCLE_TAG" ]]; then
  THISVERSION="$CIRCLE_TAG"
else
  THISVERSION="0+build"
fi
e=1 && for i in {1..5}; do
  docker build \
    --target qsiprep \
    --rm=false \
    -t pennlinc/qsiprep:latest \
    --platform linux/amd64 \
    --build-arg BUILD_DATE="$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")" \
    --build-arg VCS_REF="$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" \
    --build-arg VERSION="$THISVERSION" . \
  && e=0 && break || sleep 15
done && [ "$e" -eq "0" ]

run.name: Verify production image
run.command: docker run --rm pennlinc/qsiprep:latest --version

run.name: Deploy to Docker Hub
run.command:
if [[ -n "$DOCKER_PASS" ]]; then
  docker tag pennlinc/qsiprep:latest pennlinc/qsiprep:unstable
  docker push pennlinc/qsiprep:unstable
  if [[ -n "$CIRCLE_TAG" ]]; then
    docker tag pennlinc/qsiprep:latest pennlinc/qsiprep:$CIRCLE_TAG
    docker push pennlinc/qsiprep:latest
    docker push pennlinc/qsiprep:$CIRCLE_TAG
  fi
fi

value.name: Check latest commit for dependency edits
value.run:
CHANGED_FILES="$(git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r HEAD)"
echo "$CHANGED_FILES"
if echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -Eq '^(pyproject\.toml|pixi\.lock)$'; then
  echo "run_lockfile_update=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "run_lockfile_update=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "Latest commit did not touch pyproject.toml or pixi.lock; skipping lockfile update."
fi

value.name: Set git identity

git config --global user.name "nipreps[bot]"
git config --global user.email "bot@nipreps.org"
